# Nymrel Machine Trust Documentation for Autonomous AI Agents

> Dual-Audience Machine Trust & AI Search Discoverability Engine for Modern Web Applications.

## Core Modules

Primary TypeScript generators and validators for machine trust.

- [JSON-LD Entity Graph Generator](https://machine-trust.nymrel.com/docs/jsonld): Builds Schema.org graphs with Nymrel -> JalenBuilds LLC lineage.
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://machine-trust.nymrel.com/docs/llms-txt): Creates token-budgeted /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt machine index files.
- [Robots.txt Crawler Rules](https://machine-trust.nymrel.com/docs/robots-txt): Configures explicit rules for OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and training bots.
- [DOM Parity Validator](https://machine-trust.nymrel.com/docs/dom-parity): Guarantees zero discrepancy between JSON-LD structured data and visible DOM copy.

## Optional

- [Nymrel Umbrella](https://nymrel.com): Autonomous software systems portfolio.
- [JalenBuilds LLC](https://nymrel.com): Parent venture studio holding company.
